and I am still seeing the FileNotFoundError error. I think the verification tool is looking for the container references and the existence of the corresponding files.

Could you check whether file "/fcrepo/rest/audit/24/9d/d4/62/249dd462-ff64-41ed-ab00-192cd28b234d.ttl" is there or not? And check whether the exported audit.ttl.ttl file (/fcrepo/rest/audit.ttl) contains the reference to <
2017-05-25 13:54:32,498 INFO     Running verification on Fedora 4 export
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/Users/lsitu/Documents/Fedora_Import_Export/data_1N_v48/fcrepo/rest/audit/c0/c8/af/98/c0c8af98-72a3-4ce0-96f0-aaf9ac2aa161.ttl'

I verified that both /fcrepo/rest/audit/24/9d/d4/62/249dd462-ff64-41ed-ab00-192cd28b234d.ttl exists and is referenced from fcrepo/rest/audit.ttl.  Looks like we are using different versions the fcrepo-import-export.  The one I used is fresher.  You might want to try it with the lastest on master.

It would be nice if the verifier caught this error and handled it appropriately rather than failing out.  I hope similar errors on the Fedora tree will be caught now, but I don't think there's anything to catch errors relating to missing resources on disk yet.

Yes, we can guaranty that all the files can be exported successfully due to some server issues or the issue like referencing non-existing resources as I ran see. In this case I think it could be nice if the verification process can be completed with a full report.

I think if you delete the file /fcrepo/rest/audit/24/9d/d4/62/249dd462-ff64-41ed-ab00-192cd28b234d.ttl and try to run the verification tool again, you'll see the error. Thank you so much for sticking with it.
Verification tool now handles these errors gracefully.

comments.body: Situ, Longshou:  can you tell me the steps to reproduce?  Please include the command you used to invoke the fcrepo-import-export.  Also please attach the importexport.yml file you passed to fcrepo-verifier plus the full fcrepo-verifier command you used.  Thanks!

Danny Bernstein I think you can replicate it in the following steps with the plan patent dataset (https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-sample-dataset/blob/master/plantpatents/plants.tar.gz):

  • Restore the datatset to fedora:
    $ curl -i -X POST --data-binary "1473315261896-0" "http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/fcr:restore"
  • Export the dataset with binary excluded:
    $ java -Dfcrepo.log.importexport=DEBUG -jar bin/fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT.jar -a -d data_1 -m export -r http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
  • Verify the exported resources with the verification tool:
    fcrepo-verify -l 1-export-log.txt -g DEBUG -v ./importexport.yml

./importexport.yml:
mode: export
predicates: http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#contains
resource: http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
source: http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
dir: /Users/lsitu/Documents/Fedora_Import_Export/data_1
binaries: false
rdfLang: text/turtle
I suspect the import-export tool is excluding the audit container, and the verification tool isn't respecting that when it creates the tree of resources to check.

Situ, Longshou and Joshua Allan Westgard:   I just ran through the steps  and the fcrepo-verify ran to completion ie: 

Verified 608 resources: successes = 508, failures = 100 

No python errors.

I was using fcrepo-webapp-4.8.0-SNAPSHOT-jetty-console-a07a1a46.jar,  fcrepo-import-export 0.1.1-SNAPSHOT (5b94e13 - ie as of 1207pm), and fcrepo-import-export-verify (r. 839cb8b1)

Danny Bernstein It looks like there are some gaps there. I tested it again with fcrepo-webapp-4.8.0-SNAPSHOT-jetty-console-a07a1a46.jar and fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT-d4780ca2.jar(https://s3.amazonaws.com/f4-artifacts/fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT-d4780ca2.jar) and I am still seeing the FileNotFoundError error. I think the verification tool is looking for the container references and the existence of the corresponding files.

Could you check whether file "/fcrepo/rest/audit/24/9d/d4/62/249dd462-ff64-41ed-ab00-192cd28b234d.ttl" is there or not? And check whether the exported audit.ttl.ttl file (/fcrepo/rest/audit.ttl) contains the reference to <http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/audit/24/9d/d4/62/249dd462-ff64-41ed-ab00-192cd28b234d>?
